披星戴月的日子里，每天渴望能看到太阳

你会发现感激曾经的自己。

相信自己是最棒，好男儿莫失望。

Yurakni qulog’i yo’q kirmas aql so’zi
Soxtalarga ishongan sodda dilginam

Vafoliman deb aldar bevafo yor
Hammasiga aybdorman o’zim aybdor
Soxtalarga ishongan sodda dildinam


Yomg’ir yog’di mayda maydalab
Orzularim parcha parchalar
Ko’z yoshlarim yuzim erkalab
Seni qayta qayta eslatar

Ko’zimda nam yo’q ammo yurak yig’lar
Chidayapman hammasiga jimgina
Soxtalarga ishongan sodda dilginam

Sodda bo’lsang kularkan devona ham
Jo’ra deydi foydaxo’r begona ham
Hayot o’zi shunday ekan biri kam
Soxtalarga ishongan sodda silginam

[by:Nurdun]
[00:21.327] 被爱灼伤的心房
[00:26.558] 尝尽背叛的心房
[00:31.897] 曾在黑暗中悉心呵护
[00:37.284] 我的花儿在阴影里凋亡
[00:42.780] 如今心间游荡的
[00:47.830] 是炽热的思念 炽热的忧伤
[00:52.445] 梦想成真的渴盼
[00:57.888] 被名为遗憾的情愫阻挡
[01:02.872] 灵魂因爱人的伤害而痛
[01:05.053] 花儿啊 心也被刺伤
[01:08.203] 这颗曾为爱盈满的心
[01:10.608] 沦为嫉妒的荆棘牢笼
[01:13.487] 仰望苍穹 月也孤单
[01:16.305] 月华如你 我亦形单
[01:18.929] 左胸心口淌着血泪
[01:21.573] 失落的爱 无人相伴

[01:48.577] 伪爱猜疑皆可抛
[01:51.196] 若心焚毁 只为你燃
[01:53.827] 不为薄情之人灼烧
[01:56.647] 爱火焚心 我的心房
[01:59.464] 痛饮背叛 我的心房
[02:02.179] 曾在黑暗中精心守护

[02:09.849] 无药可医 无膏可愈

[02:15.230] 你要离去 徒留悲戚
[02:18.132] 爱火焚心 我的心房
[02:20.806] 痛饮背叛 我的心房

data.lyric:
[00:00.000] 作曲 : Aslbek Bayjanov
[00:11.284]Har gun har tun
[00:12.829]Gecha gecha
[00:13.601]Tortar koʻngl yena yena
[00:15.951]Istar qaynoq dudoqlaring
[00:20.689]Oʻrgatding san bila gora
[00:22.967]Ot bagrimda yona yona
[00:25.333]Yondim yoqdi qiynoqlaring
[00:29.614]Yetar gel yonimo sani
[00:34.323]Gutgan quchoqlarima
[00:38.565]Boʻldi yetar
[00:40.733]Yur getali
[00:43.230]Bu dunyoni uzoqlarina
[00:48.153]Ishqimiz ertagini
[00:50.728]Yazali ikkimiz
[00:52.554]Sevgi yoʻlinda
[00:56.000]Yea
[00:57.118]Sani gorish uchun buyun
[00:58.513]Yana gochangdama
[00:59.521]Gullani taqasim bo chakkaga man
[01:01.889]Qacholmisan tunu kun gochangdama
[01:04.193]Sani berasim yoq br hech kima man
[01:06.779]Bu hayolarim san bln band
[01:09.471]San azobni berjaksan
[01:11.502]Dard sorasang baraman
[01:12.927]Yuragingni barda
[01:14.041]Manda hammasi bo lekn br san kam
[01:17.043]Ortar sevgim bora bora
[01:19.505]Dala boʻldim bu yollara
[01:21.850]Duchar atding kudaklara
[01:26.668]Yurma endi toma toma
[01:28.985]Hasta boʻldim qarashlara
[01:31.363]Qoyma ortiq azoblarga
[01:35.395]Yetar
[01:37.289]Gel yanimo
[01:39.526]Sani gutgan quchoqlarima
[01:44.492]Boʻldi yetar
[01:46.665]Yur getali
[01:49.103]Bu dunyoni uzoqlarina
[01:54.188]Ishqimiz ertagin
[01:56.344]Yazali ikkimiz
[01:58.411]Sevgi yoʻlinda
[02:03.265]San mani yarim bol
[02:05.622]Tanamda jonim bol
[02:07.950]Dardima dorim bol
[02:10.387]Birgina borim bol
[02:12.716]Sani oylab gunla otar
[02:15.055]Sani oylab tunla otar
[02:17.350]Allaringni uzotmasang
[02:19.712]Yurakim shamdin arib bitar
data.name: Yetar (feat. Qahramon Ruzmetov)

[00:38.683]Davosi yo'q sen qoldirgan g'amni
[00:41.879]dardu alamni,
[00:47.409]xasta yurak davosi sen bitmas yaramni.
[00:56.369]Sen sababli ruhim tark etgan.
[00:59.741]jonsiz tanamni
[01:05.646]ketayapsan nortga bir bor boqmay bosib qadamni
[01:14.363]uzoqlashdi bizning oralar oralar
[01:18.841]xotiralar qalbim poralar poralar
[01:23.301]yetib bormasinga nolalar nolalar
[01:27.881]qolmadi hech Hech Qanday choralar,
[01:32.384]dunyolarga tenginam
[01:34.477]Ayt bevafo yorginam.
[01:36.872]Sen ham mendek birbor eslayapsanmi?
[01:41.208]Eh, koʻzlari ko'rginam tikoni bor gulginam.
[01:43.587]Mentsizlikka oson ko'nik gapsanmi
[01:50.161]dunyolarga tenginam ayt bevafo yorginam.
[01:54.828]Sen ham mendek bir bor eslayapsanmi?
[01:59.131]Eh koʻzlari ko'rginim tikoni bor gulginim
[02:01.736]mensizlikka oson ko'niksanmi?
[02:08.460]Music
[02:44.238]qaytar dunyo qaytishini sen bilmaysan.
[02:48.519]Baxtsiz qilib oʻzing baxtli boʻlmaysan.
[02:53.033]Yarim yo'lda yolg'iz qoldim bevafo.
[02:57.500]Endi meni yo'llaringda ko'rmaysan.
[03:02.067]Sheʼrlar yozdim Alamdan bitmaydigan yaramdan.
[03:06.815]Umrim oʻgan ekan bilsam mehr izlab sanamdan.
[03:10.940]Qancha qilsam ham nido
[03:13.235]sendan chiqmas bir sado
[03:15.535]aytar soʻzim dardan kuyin xayr alvido
[03:20.216]dunyolarga tengin ham ayt bevafo yorginam
[03:24.367]sen ham mendek bir bor eslayapsanmi
[03:28.878]Eh ko'zlari ko'rgin hamim tikoni bor gulginam
[03:33.342]menzlikka oson ko'nik yapsanmi
[03:37.911]dunyolarga tenginam ayt bevafo yorginam
[03:42.384]sen ham mendek bir bor eslayapsanmi
[03:46.743]eh ko'zlari ko'rgin hamim tikoni bor gulginam
[03:51.401]mensizlikka oson ko'yapsanmi

[00:50.673]Hazil bilan qara tug'ildi chaqaloq
[00:53.330]Bora bora bo'magindan endi baqaloq
[00:56.532]Telefon qilasan
[00:57.861]Har kuni bilasan
[00:59.447]Diom ishimda bo'laman
[01:01.033]Buni bilasan
[01:01.829]Jig'imga tegasan
[01:02.903]Yo atay qilasanmi
[01:05.550]Sansiz yashomiman bilasanmi
[01:07.944]Yo'q osonmas
[01:09.272]Tunlari yolg'iz qolish
[01:11.133]Nima yoqadimi o'zga bag'rida qolish
[01:13.532]Bir kdun yo'q bo'lsam
[01:14.862]O'zgardimi bolish
[01:18.055]O'zingdan mani nari nari
[01:21.244]Nari etolmaysan
[01:24.688]Jonim haydama mani mani
[01:26.816]Yo'qotib qo'ysang topa olmaysan
[01:29.486]Sevgingni endi ta'mi ta'mi
[01:30.538]Ta'mi ta'mini unutolmayman
[01:34.781]Nahot endi jonim sanirashklaringdan
[01:37.174]Hech qutula olmayman
[01:41.959]Hayotingdan nolima
[01:42.501]O'tdik qancha siinovdan
[01:43.811]Sani yashirib yurardim
[01:45.148]Begona ko'z birovdan

[01:49.661]Yashashingni xohliman

data.name: Unutolmayman
data.tlyric:
[by:Abudu_Official]
[00:02.603]Arman  2024/3/10
[00:11.911]我是你的自恋者，
[00:15.082]你不能害怕，
[00:17.737]别开车送我，
[00:19.330]如果你输了，你就找不到它，
[00:23.323]现在尝尝你的爱，
[00:25.435]忘不了味道的味道，
[00:28.626]现在我不打算和你上床了，
[00:31.032]我永远无法摆脱，
[00:35.281]谁在一开始就许下了伟大的承诺，
[00:36.339]如果我把它放在他的脖子后面，
[00:39.517]在这些 中发生了变化，找到了备份
[00:42.177]但他抛弃了我，把我关在笼子里，
[00:45.379]小姑娘，你没有超过极限吗
[00:48.023]我的脾气被一巴掌打动了
[00:50.673]婴儿出生时充满幽默感，
[00:53.330]波拉波拉波
[00:56.532]你打了个电话，
[00:57.861]你每天都知道，
[00:59.447]我会在我的工作中，
[01:01.033]你知道的
[01:01.829]你摸摸我的下巴，
[01:02.903]你会分配它吗
[01:05.550]你知道吗，我活着没有圣洁，不容易，
[01:07.944]晚上独自一人，
[01:09.272]我喜欢留在你自己的包里，
[01:11.133]如果我不是
[01:13.532]要改变
[01:14.862]我是你的自恋者，
[01:18.055]你不能害怕，
[01:21.244]别开车送我，
[01:24.688]如果你输了，你就找不到它
[01:26.816]现在尝尝你的爱，
[01:29.486]忘不了味道的味道，
[01:30.538]现在我不打算和你上床了，
[01:34.781]我永远无法摆脱，
[01:37.174]不要抱怨你的生活，
[01:41.959]已经过去了多少个
[01:42.501]我曾经藏过萨尼，
[01:43.811]来自某人的陌生人的眼神，
[01:45.148]这只是
[01:47.268]我要你活下去，
[01:49.661]我是一个忠诚的人。
[01:50.729]我是你的亲

data.name: Borolmasam
data.tlyric:
[by:MraDeL-_]
[00:22.778]Mvradil 不可逆转，
[00:23.835]人类搜索之心，
[00:29.406]他不值得你爱，
[00:34.736]别这样，阿姨，
[00:42.088]记住，你的眼睛在流泪，
[00:44.749]事实并非如此，
[00:51.120]你去过今天，
[00:56.690]他生命中的男人，
[00:58.822]每次想起你，我都会写下我的花信，
[01:01.220]我不会送命运的原因，
[01:06.794]即使你不忠于耐心，
[01:09.451]心不停爱，
[01:12.114]它只对我自己造成伤害。
[01:15.570]如果他不知道你在哭泣 心值，
[01:20.096]如果心嘲笑你，不要指望爱情，
[01:20.893]自信地生活，森达卡西南迪没有，
[01:23.022]如果我现在晚了再生，他找不到（2），
[01:25.666]如果有一天你的心很痛，
[01:28.580]如果最后几天没有我碰你的脖子，
[01:30.973]当你对更广阔的世界中的每个人都狭隘时，
[01:33.899]记住我给你的爱，我的奴隶。
[01:36.572]不可逆转，
[01:39.481]人类搜索之心，
[01:42.157]他不值得你爱，
[01:44.820]别这样，阿姨，
[01:48.003]记住，你的眼睛在流泪，

data.tlyric:
[by:JASCMB]
[by:ParhatOfficial]
[00:22.939]我也渐渐变得心如寒石
[00:28.005]我亲手，把你的名字慢慢从心底抹去
[00:33.207]曾在我掌心绽放的花，如今已然陌生
[00:38.013]亲手浇灌的美好，最终让我深陷泥沼
[00:43.091]心底藏着太多未曾说出口的话
[00:48.478]这份伤痛，终究不会就此作罢
[00:53.407]爱你本就毫无缘由，可我还是动了心
[00:57.586]唉，尽是徒劳的话语，句句皆是枉然
[01:03.369]我确实还在想你，却再也不会回到你身旁
[01:08.267]爱过便足矣，从此不再凝望你的方向
[01:13.551]只求你看着我的双眼，说出心底实话
[01:18.244]我曾给予你的深情，对你而言，真的不够吗？
[01:23.849]我确实还在想你，却再也不会回到你身旁
[01:29.194]爱过便足矣，从此不再凝望你的方向
[01:34.123]只求你看着我的双眼，说出心底实话
[01:39.376]我曾给予你的深情，对你而言，真的不够吗？
[01:44.513]是否不够，是否不够
[02:06.864]请你相信，再也不会有人像我这般
[02:09.498]倾尽真心待你
[02:12.137]你这般轻易转身的薄情之人
[02:14.631]不值得任何人倾心去爱
[02:16.908]
[02:17.737]就此收心吧，别再让心煎熬
[02:19.980]别再为这段情缘彻底沉沦
[02:22.332]你无故决然离去
[02:24.898]那我们就此走远，再不回头
[02:27.255]
[02:27.540]轻声告诉我，带着愧疚也好
[02:30.001]你会成为别人的枕边人吗？
[02:32.932]还是会像我一样满心遗憾
[02:35.390]从此觉得世间万物都索然无味？
[02:37.971]哪怕只是偶尔，你会不会想起我
[02:40.361]哪怕就一次，将我记在心底？
[02:43.182]还是会坦然投入他人怀抱
[02:45.592]彻底将过往抛在脑后？
[02:49.303]我确实还在想你，却再也不会回到你身旁
[02:54.270]爱过便足矣，从此不再凝望你的方向
[02:59.352]只求你看着我的双眼，说出心底实话
[03:04.545]我曾给予你的深情，对你而言，真的不够吗？

[00:29.487]Men senga xatlar yozdim necha bor
[00:31.286]Sog'inchim bildirib takror takror
[00:32.259]Lekin bir bora qilmading parvo
[00:35.265]Dardu alamni ko'rdingku ravo
[00:38.249]Bilmading hayolingda nimalar?
[00:41.047]O'tkinchi hoyu havas yo kimlar
[00:44.249]Kutdim balki o'zgarasan deb
[00:47.222]Xatolaring tan olasan deb
[00:50.264]O mani mani mani
[00:51.711]San bevafo deb atama
[00:53.793]Shunchaki jim hayotingdan ketaman
[00:56.819]Mani ayblashga o'ylab topma bahona
[01:00.076]Kelgan yo'lingdan mayli bo'lgin ravona
[01:03.038]O'tadi oy, o'tadi yil
[01:06.560]Baribir sensizlikka ko'nikadi dil
[01:09.502]Ovunaman, ko'nikaman
[01:11.022]Deya lekin qachon buni bilmayman
[01:14.925]Sochlarimga bugun oq oq oralar
[01:17.878]Sensizlikka bugun yo'q yo'q choralar
[01:21.019]Bilmayman qachon sani unutaman
[01:23.146]Unutaman, armon qalbimni poralar
[01:27.039]Xolimni so'rab yana bir bor kelmading
[01:30.148]Shu ko'yga solgan axir men men demading
[01:33.120]Shu kungacha bir bora yo'qlamading
[01:36.171]Yo'qlamading, xolim mani o'ylamading
[01:39.170]Sochlarimga bugun oq oq oralar
[01:42.197]Sensizlikka bugun yo'q-yo'q choralar

[01:57.412]Shu kungacha bir bora yo'qlamading
[01:59.848]Yo'qlamading, xolim mani o'ylamading
[02:05.129]Men yomon odam
[02:06.572]Senga loyiqmasman
[02:08.141]Kulrang hayotimda
[02:09.399]Tuyg'ularga joy yetmasdi
[02:11.016]Kinolardek sevgi yo'q bizga oidmas bu
[02:13.911]Tashvishlarim bilan
[02:15.365]Hayotingni boyitmasdim
[02:17.015]Bunchalar chiroyli gul ósmaydi
[02:19.045]Bu sahroda
[02:20.369]Seni baxtli qilish uchun yurdim uzuqroda
[02:22.698]Toxirmasman
[02:24.152]Loyiq bólish uchun bu Zuxroga
[02:26.073]Men seni ko'rganda...
[02:27.635]Men seni ko'rganda
[02:28.821]Yoqotib topdim o'zimni bir laxza
[02:30.214]Xar bir soniyamni sen bilan
[02:32.083]Qilgim keldi taxsim
[02:33.944]Kulguchlaringa qamalib
[02:35.380]Barmoqqa uzuk taqsam
[02:36.916]Bu serial davom etsa
[02:38.403]Baxtli onlar yuz taqsim
[02:39.953]Sen kutasan meni ishdan har kuni soģinib
[02:42.927]Farishta kabi asraysan uyimiz o'chog'ini
[02:45.713]Lekin bu orzulardagi
[02:47.281]Uyizmiz oddiy qog'ozdan
[02:49.028]Ikkimiz uchun ssenariyni
[02:50.152]O'zim qaytadan yozdim
[02:51.993]Men qishlarimda yuray
[02:53.661]Sen gulla doim yozda
[02:55.040]Yig'lasang faqat baxtdan yigla
[02:56.756]Quvonch kelsa bexosdan
[02:58.219]Barcha gaplarim yolgon
[02:59.734]Senga kerak emas rosti
[03:01.715]Men yoningda bo'lmayman
[03:02.728]Kulganingda oq libosda

data.lyric:
[00:00.000] 作词 : Bahodirjon Ahmedov
[00:01.000] 作曲 : Bahodirjon Ahmedov
[00:12.433]Sochlaring tarab kel o'zinga qarab kel
[00:14.951]Yurak nimtalab ket
[00:17.937]Kózlarimga qarab kel ayblaring sanab kel
[00:20.687]Kamimga yarab kel
[00:23.452]Bir o'zinga kelib kel vafodor bo'lib kel
[00:26.435]Yonimga kelib ket
[00:29.195]G'ururingni egib kel g'ashimga tegib kel
[00:32.192]Ovvora bo'lib kel
[00:34.698]Sevgi dona bo'ldi, hiylalaring ko'rdim
[00:37.444]Sog'inmading bo'ldi, oxirida o'ldi
[00:40.201]Oyoqlarim cho'lda, yurakkinam qo'lda
[00:42.945]Chanqaganim aytmasam
[00:44.455]Kemiysanmi yo'lda???
[00:45.940]Sizga nima bo'ldi sog'inganda sirimsiz
[00:48.445]Dunyolarni bersangizda
[00:50.689]Alishmagan pirimsiz
[00:52.155]O'ziz vampirimsiz
[00:53.155]Gap qaytarsam uribsiz
[00:54.405]Nega endi uzoqdan
[00:55.891]Kulib mag'rurdek turibsiz
[00:58.149]Qomadi vaqt asr yilim
[00:59.385]Soniya tez o'tadi kunim
[01:00.898]Qimada do'q, ko'zimda o'q
[01:02.154]Jaxlimi chiqarib ketadi yo'q
[01:03.405]Shirin zabon, qoshi kamon
[01:05.155]Sani mehring mani qildi tamom
[01:06.391]Darmon zorim qoldim zor-a
[01:07.650]Taqdirga tan berdi uni ko'rib!
[01:09.139]Alam yutib baxtni kutib
[01:10.409]Qoldim men seni kutib
[01:11.900]Kunlar o'tib ketsam o'lib
[01:13.388]Qabrimga kelgin ko'rib
[01:14.657]Yechim - uni top
[01:16.850]Tashvishlarni yop
[01:18.087]Dardlarimni ol dushmanlar alamda lol
[01:20.088]Sochlaring tarab kel o'zinga qarab kel
[01:23.607]Yurak nimtalab ket
[01:25.601]Kózlarimga qarab kel ayblaring sanab kel
[01:28.582]Kamimga yarab kel
[01:31.335]Bir o'zinga kelib kel vafodor bo'lib kel
[01:34.342]Yonimga kelib ket
[01:36.847]G'ururingni egib kel g'ashimga tegib kel
[01:39.603]Ovvora bo'lib kel
[01:43.083]Egma boshim, qaro qoshim
[01:46.287]Sindirma bardoshim o'zimni yuvoshim
[01:48.536]Ayblamagin meni qiynamagin
[01:51.289]Mehring yetar dardga siylamagin
[01:54.539]Tanda jonim yo'q endi oromim
[01:56.546]Meni kutar telbalar oroli

[00:34.415]بۇگۇن سىنى جۇدا ساغىندىم，
[00:39.199]ھەسرىتىمگە دىڭىزلار گۇۋاھ，
[00:43.682]ئاسماندىكى يۇلتۇزلار گۇۋاھ，
[00:48.434]ساغىنىشىم بولسا دە گۇناھ，
[00:53.399]بۇگۇن سىنى جۇدا ساغىندىم，
[00:57.946]ساغىندىم ۋىسالىڭنى·
[00:59.682]ساغىندىم جامالىڭنى.
[01:01.668]ساغىندىم ھايالىڭنى，
[01:04.168]ھايالىڭنى ساغىندىم.

[01:43.168]مەنگە ئىيتقان ھەر سۆزلەرىڭنى，
[01:46.679]بۇگۇن سىنى جۇدا ساغىندىم，
[01:50.683]ساچلارىڭنى ئۇچۇرار شامال，
[01:54.405]كىلەرمۇ دەپ سۇرەرمەن خىيال，
[01:57.677]سۆزۇم تىڭلا ئەي ساھىپجامال，
[02:01.671]سىنى بۇگۇن جۇدا ساغىندىم，
[02:04.930]ساغىندىم ۋىسالىڭنى·
[02:06.675]ساغىندىم جامالىڭنى.
[02:09.132]ساغىندىم ھايالىڭنى，
[02:11.419]ھايالىڭنى ساغىندىم.
[02:37.438]ئارازىڭنى سىن قويمىساڭ ھەم，
[02:38.702]ئازابىمگە كۇلۇپ ئوينىساڭ，
[02:42.916]قىنىم ئىچىپ ھىچ تويمىساڭ，
[02:47.666]بۇگۇن سىنى جۇدا ساغىندىم，
[02:52.929]ھوشيارلىكىڭ ئىركەلىكىڭنى，
[02:57.422]جىم بىلەرسە تەلبىلىكىمنى，
[03:08.911]ھەتتا خۇشال تەلبەلىكىمنى，
[03:11.179]قارىمىغىچە ھىچ تويمىسام，
[03:12.899]سىنى بۇگۇن جۇدا ساغىندىم，

[03:24.901]ھەتتا خۇشال تەلبەلىكىڭنى，
[03:26.386]ساغىندىم ۋىسالىڭنى·

[03:28.906]ساغىندىم ھايالىڭنى，
[03:30.418]ھايالىڭنى ساغىندىم.

tlyric.lyric:
[by:MraDeL-_]
[00:13.149]我不得不拒绝你，
[00:15.457]因为我这颗心正在受苦、死去，
[00:18.833]你知道你做过什么吗，
[00:20.717]现在我很不爽，
[00:24.746]我希望我可以让时光倒流，
[00:27.253]我不会再让你为我受一天苦，
[00:28.986]最后请再吻我一次，
[00:30.620]现在我很不爽，
[00:32.280]请给我一声问候，
[00:35.019]你一言不发，我就知道你很在乎，
[00:36.960]请给我，
[00:40.612]一点点问候，
[00:43.716]但愿你知道你对我做过什么，
[00:46.796]你是我的一切 — 快乐、悲伤和我的生命，
[00:49.428]我只希望你把我的那颗心还给我，
[00:52.328]自从你走后，我没有碰过别人，我只有痛苦，
[00:54.983]我在想你，我真贱，
[00:58.378]没有你，我总是魂不守舍，
[01:01.426]我对你产生依赖，
[01:04.306]我无法想象没有你的生活，
[01:07.268]当你半夜出现时，
[01:08.698]你甚至不清楚我的经历，
[01:10.177]你不要让我把你忘记，
[01:13.080]是的，我不能没有你，
[01:16.088]我像一只受伤的野兽在夜里徘徊，
[01:18.889]我在寻找沉睡的爱，
[01:20.340]是的，我不能忘记你，
[01:21.816]现在我很不爽，
[01:24.342]请给我一声问候，
[01:27.529]你一言不发，我就知道你很在乎，
[01:30.171]请给我，
[01:33.318]一点点问候，
[01:35.979]但愿你知道你对我做过什么，
[01:38.798]你是我的世界，是我的快乐、悲伤和生命，

data.name: Yori Jonim
data.lyric:
[00:00.000] 作词 : Nurmeme
[00:01.000] 作曲 : Nurmeme
[00:26.209]Suyganimsan tanho gulzor ichinda,
[00:31.677]Sani qoldirmam aslo ozor ichinda.
[00:36.189]Bir tabassum qil jonim, baxtimni ko`ray,
[00:41.142]Yashayapman dunyoda san bor uchun-da.
[00:46.193]Yor-u jonim, salomim kutgil sabodan,
[00:51.674]Sochlaringni o`ynasa mayin shabboda.
[00:56.134]Yuragingni og`ritsa sog`inch jafosi,
[01:00.888]Balki taskin toparsan shu kuy-navodan.
[01:03.222]Man sani yoring, sani vafodoring,
[01:06.148]O`ylama yolg`izman deb,
[01:08.770]Yig`lama hargizman deb,
[01:10.911]Sansiz man ojizman deb.
[01:13.952]Man sani zoring, sani intizoring,
[01:15.671]Yashayapman bir san deb,
[01:17.891]Qismatim, taqdirsan deb,
[01:39.927]Sevganimsan bir san deb.
[01:44.906]Gulnig ishqida bulbul qilganda xonish,
[01:49.463]Bulbulni zor kutar gul, gulzorda xomush.
[01:54.414]Bir-biriga yetolmay oshiq yuraklar,
[02:00.177]Biri bulbulday ko`ngil mahzun, faromush.
[02:04.527]Yor-u jonim, salomim kutgil sabodan,
[02:09.170]Sochlaringni o`ynasa mayin shabboda.
[02:13.932]Yuragingni og`ritsa sog`inch jafosi,
[02:18.890]Balki taskin toparsan shu kuy-navodan.
[02:22.438]Man sani yoring, sani vafodoring,
[02:24.760]O`ylama yolg`izman deb,
[02:26.985]Yig`lama hargizman deb,
[02:29.416]Sansiz man ojizman deb.
[02:32.970]Man sani zoring, sani intizoring,
[02:34.384]Yashayapman bir san deb,
[02:36.919]Qismatim, taqdirsan deb,
[03:22.807]Sevganimsan bir san deb.

[02:04.527]Yor-u jonim, salomim kutgil sabodan,
[02:09.170]Sochlaringni o`ynasa mayin shabboda.
[02:13.932]Yuragingni og`ritsa sog`inch jafosi,
[02:18.890]Balki taskin toparsan shu kuy-navodan.
[02:22.438]Man sani yoring, sani vafodoring,
[02:24.760]O`ylama yolg`izman deb,
[02:26.985]Yig`lama hargizman deb,
[02:29.416]Sansiz man ojizman deb.
[02:32.970]Man sani zoring, sani intizoring,
[02:34.384]Yashayapman bir san deb,
[02:36.919]Qismatim, taqdirsan deb,
[03:22.807]Sevganimsan bir san deb.

[00:01.00] 作曲 : Ziyoda
[00:02.00] 编曲 : Ziyoda
[00:08.30]To’ydim yomon, yorim,
[00:10.44]Yolg’on so’zlaringdan, bir qara.
[00:13.61]Emas oson, axir
[00:15.46]Yolg’on deya qalbimda yara.
[00:18.36]Jonim ishon, sog’insam ham,
[00:21.28]Bormayman men yolvora.
[00:23.32]Unut endi, unut endi, unut…
[00:28.61]Kuydim yomon, izlab imkon,
[00:31.48]Sen yo’q manzil axtara.
[00:34.26]Ketay qayon, yuragim qon,
[00:36.81]Bo’lmay senga masxara.
[00:39.42]Jonim ishon, o’chmas hamon
[00:42.02]Sendan qolgan dil yara.
[00:44.95]Unut endi, unut endi, unut…
[00:49.77]Unut, unut, unut, unut, unut endi,
[00:52.54]Jonim, sen ham mensizlikka ko’nik endi.
[00:55.23]Sevgimizni ikkimiz uchun ham qadri
[00:57.83]Yo’q, yo’q, yo’q, yo’q.
[01:00.45]Unut, unut, unut, unut endi,
[01:03.23]Jonim, sening hayotingda men yo’q endi,
[01:05.72]So’ramagin, avvalgidek bo’lmas bari.
[01:08.32]Yo’q!
[01:23.48]♬Music♬
[01:35.61]Ayro yo’lim, ko’nmas dilim
[01:38.66]Ayriliqning zarbiga.
[01:40.65]Men ham sendek chidolmayman,
[01:43.84]Ko’nolmayman bariga.
[01:46.38]Biz shunchaki yetolmadik
[01:49.09]Sevgimizning qadriga.
[01:51.59]Unut endi, unut endi, unut…
[01:56.84]Sen o’zgarding, men ham boshqa,
[01:59.51]Oldingidek hech nima.
[02:01.98]Majburlama, yuragingga
[02:04.69]Avvalgidek sevgima.
[02:07.60]Boshlangandi, etmay davom,
[02:09.97]Topdi sevgi hotima.
[02:12.92]Unut endi, unut endi, unut…
[02:17.64]Unut, unut, unut, unut, unut endi,
[02:20.29]Jonim, sen ham mensizlikka ko’nik endi.
[02:23.14]Sevgimizni ikkimiz uchun ham qadri
[02:25.77]Yo’q, yo’q, yo’q, yo’q.
[02:28.50]Unut, unut, unut, unut endi,
[02:31.04]Jonim, sening hayotingda men yo’q endi,

[02:39.56]Yo’q!
[02:42.92].D.G.Z.K.

tlyric.lyric:
[by:吉吉侠_]
[00:03.266]抬头望天，有多少星云？
[00:05.277]它们愁眉不展，就像睡着的我。
[00:08.269]看那雨点，一滴滴下落
[00:10.539]那是我藏起的泪珠。
[00:13.537]难道我们再也见不到？
[00:16.286]难道再不能并肩相依？
[00:19.031]难道真的永不相逢？
[00:21.276]莫非一切就此终结？
[00:25.517]我无法从爱情里抽身，做不到。
[00:30.288]我无法靠近别人，做不到。
[00:35.537]我适应不了没有你的日子，绝不妥协。
[00:41.023]嘴上说想忘，却根本忘不掉。
[00:46.287]我无法从爱情里抽身，做不到。
[00:51.789]我无法靠近别人，做不到。
[00:57.025]我适应不了没有你的日子，绝不妥协。
[01:02.017]嘴上说想忘，却根本忘不掉。
[01:08.250]当变渣成为主流，深情便是一种罪
[01:28.496]繁星夜里，空荡的街道也显甜蜜。
[01:31.740]只剩回忆陪我，孤独留在这里。
[01:33.983]繁星夜里，空荡的街道也显甜蜜。
[01:36.983]只剩回忆陪我，孤独留在这里。
[01:39.503]请你保重自己，偶尔想起我，或许就会淡忘
[01:43.418]亲爱的，我成了你的苦难。
[01:45.184]你的苦、你的痛
[01:47.430]你的容颜里都有我，别把我遗忘。
[01:51.673]看吧，从今日起，多年之后。
[01:54.675]你仍会回来看看，只剩骄傲与叹息。
[01:57.191]说实话，我也一直想念你。
[01:59.939]每个夜晚我都在想她（他）。
[02:02.439]我脑海里只有你一个人。
[02:05.189]我生命的碎片里全是你。
[02:07.947]来吧，好的，从今天就忘掉一切。
[02:10.667]像从前那样，我们一起重新幸福。
[02:13.852]我无法从爱情里抽身，做不到。
[02:18.331]我无法靠近别人，做不到。
[02:23.616]我适应不了没有你的日子，绝不妥协。
[02:29.115]嘴上说想忘，却根本忘不掉。
[02:38.051]我无法从爱情里抽身，做不到。
[02:42.553]我无法靠近别人，做不到。
[02:47.791]我适应不了没有你的日子，绝不妥协。
[02:53.051]嘴上说想忘，却根本忘不掉。

data.name: Sog'inib
data.lyric:
[00:21.09]Qani endi yonimda bo'lsa,
[00:24.32]Menga yana jilmayib kulsa,
[00:26.98]Qani endi bir daqiqaga
[00:29.60]Sog'inchimni bartaraf qilsang.
[00:32.27]Umidimni so'ndirolmayman,
[00:34.95]Haligacha voz kecholmayman,
[00:37.60]Nega, nega, aytgin menga?
[00:42.25]Sog'inchlarim bo'ldi bir dunyo,
[00:45.66]O'ngimda emasman men go'yo.
[00:48.37]Xayollar og'ushida tunlar,
[00:50.97]Faqat sen haqingdadir o'ylar.
[00:53.71]Endi seni qaytarolmayman,
[00:56.26]Sog'inchimni ayta olmayman.
[00:59.00]Nega, nega, nega?
[01:03.11]Sog'inib, sog'inib,
[01:05.65]Kechalari kuy bilan ovunib.
[01:08.40]Yoninggga men talpinib,
[01:10.97]Onda-sonda eslayman kulib.
[01:13.70]Unuta olmadim,
[01:16.33]Ne qilayin voz kecholmadim,
[01:18.93]Sevgilim, sevgilim.

tlyric.lyric:
[by:纳雅2016]
[00:21.09]若你此刻能在我身旁，
[00:24.32]若你再次对我展露笑颜，
[00:26.98]若你此刻只需片刻时光，
[00:29.60]便能抚平我所有思念。
[00:32.27]我不愿让希望熄灭，
[00:34.95]至今仍无法放弃执念，
[00:37.60]为何，为何，请告诉我答案？
[00:42.25]思念已汇成汪洋一片，
[00:45.66]我仿佛迷失了方向感。
[00:48.37]长夜沉浸在幻想臂弯，
[00:50.97]思绪只为你一人流转。
[00:53.71]如今我已无力将你唤回，
[00:56.26]也道不出心中思念滋味。
[00:59.00]为何，为何，为何？
[01:03.11]思念着，思念着，
[01:05.65]每夜与旋律相伴消磨。
[01:08.40]我挣扎着向你靠近，
[01:10.97]偶尔忆起往昔笑影。
[01:13.70]我始终无法遗忘，
[01:16.33]不知该如何才能退让，
[01:18.93]我的爱人，我的爱人。
[01:24.42]思念着，思念着，
[01:26.97]每夜与旋律相伴消磨。
[01:29.70]我挣扎着向你靠近，
[01:32.33]偶尔忆起往昔笑影。
[01:35.04]我始终无法遗忘，
[01:37.60]不知该如何才能退让，
[01:40.27]我的爱人，我的爱人。
[01:45.72]或许时间能治愈一切，
[01:49.68]但不知要等到何年何月。
[01:52.35]也许我的心终将习惯，
[01:54.99]生活会教会我适应孤单。
[01:57.68]我活在渺茫的希望里，
[02:00.30]却不知能坚持到几时，
[02:02.95]为何，为何，请告诉我答案？
[02:07.57]我不愿诅咒你的命运，
[02:11.02]只祈求你能幸福安宁。
[02:13.65]即便不是今日或明天，
[02:16.31]我也会学会适应孤单。
[02:18.97]我会在内心寻找力量，
[02:21.70]或许某天能彻底遗忘。
[02:24.32]为何，为何，为何？
[02:28.45]思念着，思念着，
[02:31.04]每夜与旋律相伴消磨。
[02:33.75]我挣扎着向你靠近，
[02:36.28]偶尔忆起往昔笑影。
[02:39.00]我始终无法遗忘，
[02:41.63]不知该如何才能退让，
[02:44.29]我的爱人，我的爱人。
[02:49.58]思念着，思念着，
[02:52.32]每夜与旋律相伴消磨。
[02:55.03]我挣扎着向你靠近，
[02:57.59]偶尔忆起往昔笑影。
[03:00.32]我始终无法遗忘，
[03:02.97]不知该如何才能退让，

data.name: Jonim
data.lyric:
[00:00.000] 作词 : Hilola Samirazar
[00:01.000] 作曲 : Hilola Samirazar
[00:18.102]Jonim，
[00:20.101]​O, maning jonim!
[00:25.106]​Borliging baxt ozi men uchun!
[00:33.112]​Netay, seni soginsam kunu tun?
[00:35.108]​Senda，
[00:37.107]​Xayolim senda!
[00:41.100]​Lek ozing bilmaysan, ayt, nechun?
[00:48.101]Keldim yana yoningga ushbu kun，
[00:52.104]Qaniydi baxtim yana kulsaydi!
[00:56.106]Visoling menga nasib bolsaydi!
[01:01.109]Qaniydi qalbing shuni bilsaydi，
[01:05.101]​Har lahza!
[01:09.109]Qaniydi baxtim yana kulsaydi!
[01:13.105]Visoling menga nasib bolsaydi!
[01:17.102]Qaniydi qalbing shuni sezsaydi，
[01:38.114]Har lahza!
[01:39.108]♬♪♬♪♬Dada RaDaa♬♪♬♪，
[01:41.107]Jonim，
[01:45.105]San maning jonim!
[01:47.110]Menga ham shunday so‘z deginki –，
[01:55.102]Ishon, sengadir borim, hayotim!
[01:56.107]Jonim!
[02:03.114]Meni har doim，
[02:10.116]Hech kim sevmagandak sevginki，
[02:15.115]Dilda qolmasin aslo armonim!
[02:17.109]Qaniydi baxtim yana kulsaydi!
[02:19.113]Visoling menga nasib bolsaydi!
[02:22.104]Qaniydi qalbing shuni bilsaydi，
[02:26.103]Har lahza!
[02:31.100]Qaniydi baxtim yana kulsaydi!
[02:34.111]Visoling menga nasib bolsaydi!
[02:38.109]Qaniydi qalbing shuni sezsaydi，
[02:44.102]Har lahza！

data.name: Sevgi Alam
data.lyric:
[00:00.00] 作词 : Endi Yoq
[00:00.00] 作曲 : Endi Yoq
[00:00.00]Goh sharbat gohogu 哦沙巴特戈乌
[00:51.37]Kohna gamga kozgu科赫纳甘加科兹古
[00:57.00]Navqiron sevgi bu纳吾克兰的爱
[01:00.74]Qoshiqlarimda qayta yaraldi乔希克拉林达
[01:07.37]Ham hijron ham visol悲欢离合
[01:12.73]Sen hayot Sen hayot 你世界
[01:18.01]Bogda bir gul misol 博格达比尔古尔米索尔
[01:21.14]Erkam kuy bolib men senga taraldim埃尔卡姆 库伊博利布 门森加塔拉迪姆
[01:31.33]Sevgi-alam爱情 阿拉姆
[01:32.41]Yuragimga malham尤拉金加马勒姆
[01:38.69]Seni sogindim塞尼索格丁
[01:42.73] jon erkam琼埃尔卡姆
[01:48.57]Yol ham约尔火腿
[01:51.69]Yolgiz sen tomon约尔格兹森托蒙
[01:56.33]Titrab yonar sham提特拉布约纳尔 沙姆
[02:01.01]Nurlarim bir tutam努拉里姆比尔图坦
[02:03.62]Saqlab uni sondirmay bir dam萨克拉布统一所以
[02:06.34]Asrab olmoq armon阿斯拉布奥莫克–阿蒙
[02:24.69]Goh dunyo tor goh keng戈敦约托尔高肯，
[02:38.05]Borlik yoqlikka teng博利克约克利卡滕
[02:47.37]Sen yagonamsan eng
[02:55.37]Erkam如果你是亚戈南桑恩埃尔卡姆
[03:13.41]Sevilganlar ichra tanhoman Jon har yondir zor-zor塞维尔甘斯乔恩哈 扬迪尔硬硬
[03:39.69]Dosh bersang bas yurak Oy-quyoshdan darak多什 贝桑低音尤拉克 奥伊库约什丹，
[04:17.77]Erkam埃尔卡姆
[04:21.85]Tun koksini yorgan ziyoman通焦炭被子齐约曼

data.name: yurak yanar yar
data.lyric:
作词 : Dilxot Curbon
作曲 : Dilxot Curbon
yurak yanar yar 
你做了什么心事
kozyaxka tolar yar
你是理智的
soygu azabi 
你做了什么心事
yurakta yax akar yar
aklimni algan sin exki dardi salgan sin
你是理智的，你做了什么心事 
bilmay yurp kulganda 
他不知道笑的时候
exki dardini salgan san 
你做了什么心事
dana dana hali bar 
有一把哈利。
nazi nazi nazibar 
纳兹有纳兹。
mandin baxkilara kozlare surma
从我开始我的眼睛是黑色的。
kilip bilmay min daydimni aqa
我不知道自己的苦。
sin kuwaq dardim bildim 
吻你的痛苦
san koglvni aqtig 
你打开你的心扉。
svgindim kalyanim makay 
你爱我的人你来吧
svginim kal bagrim makay 
我爱的你就来吧
soygvnim kal kogligni aqa
你爱我就喝你的心
kilip bilmay min daydimni aqa
我不知道自己的苦。
sin kuwaq dardim bildim 
吻你的痛苦
san koglvni aqtig 
你打开你的心扉。 
dur dur durdana
是湿的
mandin janin birdana 
亲爱的我的一个
qiraylik san ay dana 
漂亮的你爱的
soydum sini ras dana 
我真的吻了你。
kaximni kakma baxkaga bakma 
dur dur durdana,manu janin birdana
是一种湿的，把（这个）
qiraylik san aydanam
漂亮的你爱的
soydum sini ras danam
我真的吻了你。
asmanda aysan sozlari bay san 
天上的月亮你说得富。
xohlikni koymadig nimanqa taysan
你怎么这么不调皮？
oylanip yurma kat dima kulma
你别在想了就别在想了
mandin baxkalara kozlare surma
从我开始我的眼睛是黑色的。
不要抱怨乌鸦

data.name: Xasta Bo'lma
data.lyric:
[00:00.00] 作词 : Shakhriyor Argonov
[00:01.00] 作曲 : Shakhriyor Argonov
[00:23.05]Seni hamma-hammadan yaxshi ko'rib, sevaman,
[00:29.64]Bilib-bilmay ba'zida qalbing ozor beraman.
[00:36.09]Xasta bo'lib qolsang gar, aniq ado bo'laman,
[00:42.85]Kasal bo'lma iltimos, sensiz nima qilaman?
[00:49.60]Bizga baxtlar yarashadi, armon emas,
[00:56.23]O'zga yorlar kulgulari darmon emas,
[01:02.97]Boshqa birov sendek bo'lolmas.
[04:24.36][03:59.84][03:13.03][02:49.84][01:33.04][01:09.69]Xasta Bo'lma jonim ado bo'laman
[04:29.68][04:06.41][03:19.66][02:56.38][01:39.75][01:16.38]Mendan oldinalmi eshon olib bo'laman
[04:36.29][04:12.97][03:26.24][03:02.99][01:46.20][01:22.87]Senga men zor bo'laman,
[04:39.28][04:15.85][03:29.25][03:05.94][01:49.24][01:25.87]Sensiz men xor bo'laman
[04:44.56][04:19.45][03:32.65][03:09.58][01:52.75][01:29.30]Azizim...
[02:20.36]Seni hatdo ozgalaru ozimdan ham qizghonib
[02:27.16]Korsam deyman seni harkun yuragim yonib
[02:33.65]Gohida men ozum ros sozlardan ham tonib
[02:40.46]Kesal bolma eltimos yiglayman sensiz qolib
[05:06.01]970234❤

tlyric.lyric:
[by:Yamazaki-Aisu]
[00:23.05]真心爱你，对你的爱深如大海
[00:29.64]不知不觉有时也会伤到你心
[00:36.09]你若抱病不起，我将心碎一地
[00:42.85]求你，不要生病...不然我不知如何....
[00:49.60]“白头偕老”才是初衷，而非“美梦一场”
[00:56.23]非你不可，他人笑声不能愈伤
[01:02.97]没有人能像你一样陪伴我
[01:09.69]请别生病，亲爱的，我会泪流满面

lrc.lyric:
作词 : AlimOfficial
作曲 : AlimOfficial
Qo`shiqlarim,kuylarimga
Maftun bo`lib o`zing topibsan.
Yuragingga toza tuyg`ular
Ichra mening ismim yozibsan.

Baxt-omadim shudir balki,
Yana mening bordir keragim.
Lekin senmas men kutgan yor,
Sen emassan mening tilagim.

Unut meni,arzimasman
Sening toza izhorlaringga.
Men o`zimni kechirolmasman,
Zarra ozor yetsa qalbingga.
Qo`ygin meni,arzimasman,
Senga dilim tutolmasman.
Bir bevafo tilgan qalbimni
Senga ravo ko`rolmasman.
Ardoqlagin deyman o`zingni,

data.tlyric:
[by:JASCMB]
[00:42.186]这颗心又一次饮下爱恋的醇酒，满心都是你
[00:51.185]心绪纷乱早已乱了方寸，我不知该如何是好
[00:59.184]我的心全然信赖你，早已放下世间所有旁人
[01:07.439]意思就是，它一心一意、唯独只需要你
[01:18.434]我不需要明月，也不需要漫天繁星
[01:28.685]等不到明天，今日必须见到你
[01:38.692]没有你的日子算不上日子，寂静长夜也毫无意义
[01:50.431]我此刻彻底明白，今天一定要见到你
[02:01.438]（间奏）
[02:36.442]失去你的我已然为爱疯癫，模样憔悴不堪
[02:44.441]多想伸手接过你递来的爱情美酒
[02:52.683]旁人脸上眼底，都没有你这般暖阳光彩
[03:00.682]你于我人生之中，是一本藏着爱意、我尚未读懂的神秘书卷
[03:10.935]我不需要明月，也不需要漫天繁星
[03:21.685]等不到明天，今日必须见到你
[03:32.692]没有你的日子算不上日子，寂静长夜也毫无意义
[03:43.186]我此刻彻底明白，今天一定要见到你
[03:54.437]（间奏）

data.name: Sensiz Gulim
data.lyric:
[00:00.000] 作词 : Xamdam Sobirov
[00:01.000] 作曲 : Xamdam Sobirov
[00:09.193]Mango Guruhi - Sensiz Gulim
[00:22.646]Yolg`iz qoldim qorong`u bu zulmat xona,
[00:27.638]Dardlarimga sherik bo`ldi faqat xona.
[00:32.887]Endi shafqat kutmasman hech do`stimdan ham,
[00:37.891]Sen ham tashlab ketmoqdasan mani.
[00:43.137]Mayli, ko`nay bu hayotning azobiga,
[00:48.387]Qoqilsam gar bu alamlar girdobiga.
[00:53.391]Qolib ketay yolg`onlaring sarobiga,
[00:58.636]Bir bor meni o`yladingmi, gulim?
[01:03.387]Sensiz-sensiz kunim, o`tar har bir tunim,
[01:08.391]Charchab ketdim gulim, qiynalmoqda dilim.
[01:13.395]Sensiz-sensiz kunim, o`tar har bir tunim,
[01:18.641]Charchab ketdim, charchab ketdim…
[01:23.890]Sensiz-sensiz kunim, o`tar har bir tunim,
[01:28.894]Charchab ketdim gulim, qiynalmoqda dilim.
[01:34.141]Sensiz-sensiz kunim, o`tar har bir tunim,
[01:39.390]Charchab ketdim, charchab ketdim…
[01:44.394]《Mango Guruhi Rep...》
[01:47.389]Kechdingmi ayt, nima sabab?
[01:49.843]Ketgan kuningdan boshlandi,
[01:51.097]Yurakda bor davosi yo`q bir dard.
[01:53.847]Alam, so`nggi payt tinmasdan seni o`ylar edim,
[01:57.795]Sen esa o`ylamasdan qilding xiyonat, nega ayt?
[02:01.751]Sen esa bahonalar qilar eding,
[02:03.192]Qilmadim deb sizga xiyonat,
[02:05.443]Yo`q, eshitmayman, bo`ldi hammasi tamom.
[02:07.940]Axir mendan kechib nimalarga erishmoqchi bo`lding, ayt?
[02:10.947]Gap boylikda bo`lsa agar, qancha kerak senga, ayt?
[02:13.443]Qilmishlaring juda og`ir, kulaymi yo yig`laymi?
[02:16.195]Bu yolg`on dunyodan ketaymi yo qolaymi?
[02:18.692]Ha, gapir, nega jimsan, ayt?
[02:20.942]Eh, qilib xiyonat, endi kimsan, ayt?
[02:23.696]Yoki men ham senday soxta oshiq bo`laymi?
[02:26.446]Muhabbatimni har kun pulga chaqib sotaymi?
[02:28.942]Va’dalari yolg`onchi yor, aldading-ey,
[02:34.192]Dilim ezib, hijronlarga tashlading-ey.
[02:39.195]Seni sevdim o`zgani hech sevmasdan-ey,
[02:44.441]Nahot, meni o`ylamading, aytgin gulim?
[02:49.691]Endi men kimni sevib, kimni bilay?
[02:54.949]Dardlarimni kimga aytay, kimga yig`lay?
[02:59.942]Va’da berib, va’dangga sen vafo qilmay,
[03:05.190]O`lgan sevgimizni, aytgin, qayga ko`may?
[03:09.695]Sensiz-sensiz kunim, o`tar har bir tunim,
[03:14.699]Charchab ketdim gulim, qiynalmoqda dilim.
[03:19.946]Sensiz-sensiz kunim, o`tar har bir tunim,
[03:25.139]Charchab ketdim, charchab ketdim…
[03:30.389]Sensiz-sensiz kunim, o`tar har bir tunim,
[03:35.327]Charchab ketdim gulim, qiynalmoqda dilim.
[03:40.528]Sensiz-sensiz kunim, o`tar har bir tunim,
[03:45.775]Charchab ketdim, charchab ketdim…
[03:51.524]∮Music∮ ∮音乐∮ ∮Mango Guruhi∮

data.name: Yomon Ekanda
data.lyric:
[00:00.00] 作词 : Bahrom Nazarov
[00:01.00] 作曲 : Bahrom Nazarov
[00:21.1]Bu taqdirning qo'llarida
[00:24.11]Inson hayot yo'llarida
[00:26.76]Kulib turgan omadidan ayrilgani yomon ekanda
[00:34.65]Yo'qlab kelmas biror kishi
[00:37.64]Tobora ortar tashvishi
[00:40.21]Kecha oson bitgan ishi bitmay qolsa, yomon ekanda
[00:47.93]Kecha seni qilib e'zoz
[00:50.71]Poyingga bo'lib poyandoz
[00:53.57]Bugun o'shal masxaraboz pand bergani yomon ekanda
[01:01.35]Bu taqdirning qo'llarida
[01:04.19]Inson hayot yo'llarida
[01:06.98]Kulib turgan omadidan ayrilgani yomon ekanda
[01:14.61]Yomon, yomon, yomon ekanda
[01:20.9]Yolg'iz qolish yomon ekanda
[01:25.37]Yomon, yomon, yomon ekanda
[01:30.70]Omad ketsa, yomon ekanda
[01:34.61]♬~ Musiqa ~♬
[01:57.32]Quloq solmay do'st so'ziga
[02:00.28]Kecha urganding yuziga
[02:02.97]Hol so'rab kelsa ko'ziga
[02:05.55]Qarolmasang, yomon ekanda
[02:10.83]Kecha xo'p zamon ekanda
[02:13.66]Hamma sen tomon ekanda
[02:16.8]Bugun xatolaring sanab
[02:18.70]Afsus qilsang, yomon ekanda
[02:24.12]Ko'ngil emas hamyonga yor
[02:26.94]Kelgan davr-u davronga yor
[02:29.33]Davring ketsa, o'sha nigor
[02:32.17]Sendan qochsa, yomon ekanda
[02:37.33]Haqqa ayon qilg'ilig'i
[02:40.17]Iymon buzar goh qilig'i
[02:42.76]Yor deganing u bor-yo'g'i dilsiz chiqsa, yomon ekanda
[02:51.29]Kuyinma ko'p dilim aslo
[02:53.63]Bu shundayin g'alat dunyo
[02:57.10]Gar "Ol qulim", desa Xudo
[03:00.55]Egik boshing osmon ekanda
[03:03.90]♬~ Musiqa ~♬
[03:11.98]Yomon, yomon, yomon ekanda
[03:17.41]Yolg'iz qolish yomon ekanda
[03:22.54]Yomon, yomon, yomon ekanda
[03:27.93]Omad ketsa, yomon ekanda
[03:32.38]♬~ Musiqa ~♬

[00:00.00] 作词 : ELEP BAR
[00:00.00] 作曲 : ELEP BAR
[00:00.00]سەن ئەمەسسەن مىنىڭ تىلەكىم.
[00:10.00]سۆزى،مۇزىكىسى:
[00:43.00]مەپتۇن بولۇپ ئۆزۈڭ تىپىپسەن.
[00:47.00]يۈرەگىڭ تۇيسە تۇيغۇلار،
[00:53.00]ئىچىرە مىنىڭ ئىسمىم يىزىپسەن.
[00:56.00]بەخت ئامىتىم شۇدۇر بەلكىم،
[01:02.00]يەنە مىنىڭ باردۇر كىرىكىم،
[01:06.00]لىكىن سەن ئەمەس مەن كۈتكەن يار،
[01:15.00]ئۇنۇت مىنى، ئەرزىمەسمەن،
[01:20.00]سىنىڭ سۆيگۈ ئىزھارلىرىڭگە،
[01:24.00]مەن ئۆزۈمنى كەچۈرەلمەسمەن،
[01:28.00]زەرە ئازار يەتسە قەلبىڭگە.
[01:32.00]قويغىن مىنى ئەرزىمەسمەن،
[01:36.00]ساڭا دىلىم بىرەلمەسمەن.
[01:42.00]بىر بىۋاپا تىلغان قەلبىمنى،
[01:46.00]ساڭا راۋا كۆرەلمەسمەن.
[02:26.00]قەدىرلىكىم دەيمەن ئۆزۆڭنى،
[02:31.00]ياشلىمىغىن بىكار كۆزۈڭنى،
[02:35.00]بىلگىن دەيمەن، سۆيگىن دەيمەن،
[02:40.00]سۆيگۈ قەدرى بىلگەن ئىنساننى.
[02:45.00]نە قىلار مەن ئالداپ مەن سىنى،
[02:49.00]ئىغىر ئالما ئىيتقان سۆزۈمنى،
[02:54.00]مىنىڭ ھەم بىر سۆيگۈم بار ئىدى،
[02:58.00]ئىلىپ كەتكەن مىنىڭ قەلبىمنى.

[03:29.00]بىر بىۋاپا تىلغان قەلبىمنى،

data.name: Ko'rmadim
data.lyric:
[00:00.00] 作词 : Bahodirjon Ahmedov
[00:01.00] 作曲 : Bahodirjon Ahmedov
[00:06.7]Lyrics By: DENGIZ
[00:10.63]Texet By: DENGIZ
[00:23.10]Bugun Yana Xasta yuragim, o'jarga aylandi keragim,
[00:27.85]Yuragimga birma ozor, boshida deinku bezor,
[00:33.50]Sog'indim qancha bo'lsa ham, sevgiga berolmadim dam,
[00:38.76]Aslida kim yomon ekan, seni sevdim aytgin kimda kam.
[00:43.79]Yuragimga to'la boshladi dart, so'ngra menga qo'ya boshladin shart.
[00:49.9]Qalbing tubi qila boshladi g'arq, o'gratib qo'yib etma meni,
[00:54.31]dart dart dart dart bermagin, shart shart shart shart qo'ymagin.
[00:59.36]O'gratib qo'yib o'zinga meni, qarab to'ymadim ko'zinga seni.
[01:04.63]Ko'rmadim yana sendayin ko'rmadim o'zgaga ko'ngil bo'lmadi,
[01:11.53]Yana sendayin ko'rmadim-ko'rmadim. Ko'rmadim yana sendayin ko'rmadim o'zgaga ko'ngil bo'lmadi,
[01:21.78]Yana sendayin ko'rmadim-ko'rmadim.
[01:26.92]♬Music♬
[01:46.73]Ey qoshlari qalam yuragimda alam, bir bora qadamlaringni qani men tamonga sana, Ey qoshlari qalam nega ko'zingda alam bergan etiborlaringi menga qilmagin tana,
[01:57.45]Ey nozlari baland nega osmondasana, ozgina pastroq tushgina sendan yuqoridamana. O'zizcha oliftasizda ko'zlarimiz olasiz, agar shu ketish bo'lsa 30yoshda yolg'iz qolasiz.
[02:07.93]Ey poshnasi baland bildik obro'yiz baland, bilmadik qayerdan kelgan sizga bunqa taland. Ko'zlaringa qarab turib qilaman yuragini yara, agar ko'rishmoqchi bo'lsang soatlab o'zinga qara,
[02:18.60]Sovchilarim yuboraman menga turmishga chiqasiz axir keyingi yigla yigirma birga ham chiqasiz, Yoshiz yelgandan kegin boshqa nima ham qilasiz,taklifimi o'ylab ko'rin yana o'zingiz bilasiz.
[02:28.89]Yana yana yana-yana o'gratib qo'yding, Yana yana yana-yana unitib qo'yding.
[02:34.62]Yana yana yana-yana sevdirib qo'yding, Yana yana yana-yana o'gratib qo'yding.
[02:39.61]Yana yana yana-yana o'gratib qo'yding, Yana yana yana-yana unitib qo'yding.
[02:44.90]Yana yana yana-yana sevdirib qo'yding, Yana yana yana-yana o'gratib qo'yding.
[02:50.26]Ko'rmadim yana sendayin ko'rmadim o'zgaga ko'ngil bo'lmadi, Yana sendayin ko'rmadim-ko'rmadim.
[03:00.68]Ko'rmadim yana sendayin ko'rmadim o'zgaga ko'ngil bo'lmadi,
[03:11.16]Ahvolimni ham tushinmaysam, uylanib ketsam ulgurmaysan. Ey vaqt borida qadrimni bil, e ko'p gapirma aytganimni qil.
[03:21.31]Bu go'zlaning qalin qoshlari, qilgan nozlari o'gratib boshlarim, Bunchalar shirin qilgan oshlari, hech ham to'kmayman ko'zidan yoshlarim.
[03:32.1]Yorima meni jonima, tushingin axir ahvolima. Netay axir ko'nglim senda, kuning o'tadi har kun netda.
[03:42.66]Sochlaring bo'yab sariqa, o'xshab qolibsan oq baliqa.
[03:47.98]Qoshingda o'smaalari qalin, o'sha botekiz labindan seni,
[03:53.37]Ko'rmadim yana sendayin ko'rmadim o'zgaga ko'ngil to'lmadi, Yana sendayin ko'rmadim-ko'rmadim.
[04:03.79]Ko'rmadim yana sendayin ko'rmadim o'zgaga ko'ngil to'lmadi, Yana sendayin ko'rmadim-ko'rmadim.
[04:18.9].D.G.Z.K.

[00:00.00] 作词 : Xamdam Sobirov
[00:01.00] 作曲 : Xamdam Sobirov
[00:02.00] 编曲 : Xamdam Sobirov
[00:12.00][Xamdam]
[00:22.84]Xayolim joyidamas, aqldan ozdim,
[00:25.53]To`g`ri yo`l tanlamadim, baxtimdan qochdim.
[00:28.16]Hiylayu-fitnalarga yuragimdan joy berdim,
[00:30.84]Nahotki, qo`limdagi omadimni boy berdim?
[00:33.38]Nimalar yo`qotdim, nimalarni topdim,
[00:36.02]Orzularim yo`lini birin-ketin yopdim.
[00:38.93]Balki bu sinovmi yoki taqdir peshona,
[00:41.60]Meni ado qilmasaydi shu kichkina xona.
[00:43.88][Ziyoda]
[00:44.08]Qaytadimi hayotimga men yo`qotgan bahorlar,
[00:48.71]Aytadimi suyukligim qulog`imga izhorlar?
[00:54.56]Kulsam, endi meni yig`latmanglar,
[00:59.36]Yerda yursam, bas yashashni menga o`rgatmanglar.
[01:05.24]To`rt devor orasidaman, olib ket, olib ket,
[01:10.35]Qara, men jar yoqasidaman olib ket, olib ket,
[01:15.60]Endi kimlar qafasidaman olib ket, olib ket, olib ket.
[01:20.85][Xamdam]
[01:26.55]Qani endi hammasini oq qog`ozdan boshlasam,
[01:29.18]Bu holatda bo`lmasmidim to`g`ri qadam tashlasam?
[01:31.77]Kim aslida kimligini hozirgidek bilsaydim,
[01:34.42]Ko`zlariga qarab turib, yolg`onlarin ko`rsaydim.
[01:37.18]Yaqin insonlarimni, qadrimni yo`qotmasdim,
[01:39.93]Ikki dunyo xiyonatning botqog`iga botmasdim.
[01:42.59]Balki bu sinovmi yoki taqdir peshona,
[01:45.42]Meni ado qilmasaydi shu kichkina xona.
[01:47.68][Ziyoda]
[01:47.94]Qaytadimi hayotimga men yo`qotgan bahorlar,
[01:53.25]Aytadimi suyukligim qulog`imga izhorlar?
[01:58.48]Kulsam, endi meni yig`latmanglar,
[02:03.33]Yerda yursam, bas yashashni menga o`rgatmanglar.
[02:09.18]To`rt devor orasidaman, olib ket, olib ket,
[02:14.34]Qara, men jar yoqasidaman olib ket, olib ket,
[02:19.79]Endi kimlar qafasidaman olib ket, olib ket, olib ket.
[02:25.01]Men bugun yana zulmatda yonaman,
[02:35.82]Ucholmayman, shu qafasda qolaman.
[02:41.48]Azoblarim qanchadan qancha,
[02:44.44]Dardlarim anchadan ancha.
[02:47.79]Ey, hayot qiynama buncha,
[02:49.78]Qiynaldim qancha.
[02:55.24]Forme118

[00:32.690]随其自然，放任自流
[00:37.868]任爱耗尽燃尽所有
[00:43.369]无论贫穷富有,悲欢离合
[00:46.869]我们也将永不分离
[00:51.619]或许这是命运之尘事

data.lyric:
[00:00.000] 作词 : Toxir Sulton
[00:01.000] 作曲 : Toxir Sulton
[00:21.456]Dunyo ekki tamom bilgin nigorim,
[00:31.957]Kim o'ynadi kim yig'ladi dildorim.
[00:42.707]Kim u tamom kim bu tamom sarsonim,
[00:53.458]Sen yig'lading men o'ynadim nigorim.
[01:03.707]Yig'ladi yig'ladi yig'ladi yuragim,
[01:06.207]Topmadi sendak nigorim....!
[01:14.458]Bu kecha oyga boqib so'zlarimni,
[01:17.208]Tinglagin bir bor dildorim.
[01:24.957]Yig'ladi yig'ladi yig'ladi yuragim,
[01:27.707]Topmadi sendak nigorim....!
[01:35.708]Bu kecha oyga boqib so'zlarimni,
[01:38.208]Tinglagin bir bor dildorim.
[01:43.958]Music 音乐 Accord
[02:08.208]Dardim aytsam oy xam yig'lar dildorim,
[02:18.458]Dil yig'lasa bir bor esla nigorim.
[02:29.708]Mendan yiroq kitar bo'lding dilrorim,
[02:40.144]Alam qilar yurak sensiz nigorim.
[02:50.144]Yig'ladi yig'ladi yig'ladi yuragim,
[02:53.131]Topmadi sendak nigorim....!
[03:01.063]Bu kecha oyga boqib so'zlarimni,
[03:03.564]Tinglagin bir bor dildorim.
[03:11.564]Yig'ladi yig'ladi yig'ladi yuragim,
[03:14.314]Topmadi sendak nigorim...!
[03:22.314]Bu kecha oyga boqib so'zlarimni,
[03:24.814]Tinglagin bir bor dildorim.
[03:30.564]Music 音乐 Accord
data.name: Nigorim
data.tlyric:
[by:JASCMB]
[00:21.456]心上人，你要明白世事本就无常
[00:31.957]有人欢喜欢愉，有人暗自落泪
[00:42.707]有人圆满顺遂，而我只剩漂泊狼狈
[00:53.458]那时是你落泪，我肆意快活
[01:03.707]我的心不停流泪、不停酸楚
[01:06.207]再也遇不到像你一样的心上人
[01:14.458]今夜我望着明月诉说心里话
[01:17.208]我的爱人，请你听我一回
[01:24.957]我的心不停流泪、不停酸楚
[01:27.707]再也遇不到像你一样的心上人
[01:35.708]今夜我望着明月诉说心里话
[01:38.208]我的爱人，请你听我一回
[01:43.958]（间奏）
[02:08.208]若是把满心苦楚讲出，连明月都会落泪
[02:18.458]当我内心痛苦煎熬，盼你能记起我
[02:29.708]你已经远远离我而去
[02:40.144]没有你，我的心满是煎熬伤痛
[02:50.144]我的心不停流泪、不停酸楚
[02:53.131]再也遇不到像你一样的心上人
[03:01.063]今夜我望着明月诉说心里话
[03:03.564]我的爱人，请你听我一回
[03:11.564]我的心不停流泪、不停酸楚
[03:14.314]再也遇不到像你一样的心上人
[03:22.314]今夜我望着明月诉说心里话
[03:24.814]我的爱人，请你听我一回
[03:30.564](间奏)

[01:12.80]Менга ўзинг керак,
[01:16.77]сенсиз бемор қалбимда ўқ.
[01:20.58]Нимадур қилиш керак,
[01:24.51]сенсиз уйқуни билмайман,
[01:28.50]Менга ўзинг керак,
[01:32.33]сенсиз яшай олмайман,
[01:36.23]Яшай олмайман.

[01:57.37]Шу қўшиқ ҳам яралмаган бўларди.

[00:33.41]日子一天天按部就班地流逝，
[00:37.36]思念着你，我深陷于无数离别之苦。

[00:45.17]我渴望再次见到你。
[00:49.04]写给我的信，你从不回复，
[00:52.95]别说“我现在很平静”来安慰我。
[00:56.86]为何你总是折磨我，让我受尽痛苦，
[01:00.71]你不思念我的原因是什么？
[01:05.26]我该如何是好，
[01:08.96]没有你 我便没有安宁，
[01:12.80]我需要的只是你，
[01:16.77]没有你 我病态的心中留有伤痕。
[01:20.58]我总得做点什么，
[01:24.51]没有你 我无法入眠，
[01:28.50]我需要的只是你，
[01:32.33]没有你 我无法活下去，
[01:36.23]无法活下去。
[01:53.48]若你能如我爱你般爱我，

[02:40.43]我总得做点什么，

lrc.lyric:
作词 : Mango Guruhi
作曲 : Mango Guruhi
Siz uchun hatto jonim beraman deb，
即使为你献上我的灵魂，
Yuragimni har bir zarbida siz deb，
随着你每一次触动我的内心，
Yolg'onlaringga cho'ktirib ketting，
难道都是虚假的妥协，
Bir umr faqat sizni sevaman deb，
只有爱你一辈子，
Siz uchun hatto jonim beraman deb，
即使为你献上我的灵魂，
Yuragimni har bir zarbida siz deb，
随着你每一次触动我的内心，
Qasamlaringni unutib ketting，
难道你忘了我们许下的那些誓言，
Endi sensiz kelar ketar fasllar，
如今季节停转，
Manga faqat siz kerak, kerak emas qasrlar，
你坦言再不需要遮蔽的宫殿，
Yarim yo'lda bo'linib ketdi manzillar，
拆毁掉我们的爱巢，
Sezmabsan sani sevganimni qanchalar，
可Sezmabsan仍深爱着sani，
To'rt tarafimdan ezaveradi devor，
感觉被四面墙壁围困，
Sen kettingu va dunyo bo'ldi qoldi tor，
在这狭窄的地方，
Kim bilan uyquga ketmoqdasan kechalar，
夜深时你和谁相伴入眠，
Shu haqida o'ylasam netay yurak sanchilar，
为何我的心脏如此疼痛。

data.tlyric:
[by:Yodikor-Ruziboyev]
[00:35.30]都不知是否该信你说的话了

[01:10.30]一滴两滴…泣不成声，泣涕如雨
[01:13.50]然而这都对你无足轻重
[01:17.00]够了，让我一个人待一会儿
[01:20.10]别说了，听累了你的解释
[01:23.40]一滴两滴…泣不成声，泣涕如雨

[01:58.60]适可而止吧，你这厚颜无耻的账
[01:59.80]是你扼杀了这份爱情，别再解释了
[02:01.30]心在燃烧，不为别的，就为给你的青春
[02:04.70]开始后悔…早知今日，何必当初
[02:08.70]怎么说都无法挽留…你安静点儿吧

[02:22.40]这下安静点儿，听听我在你面前的委屈
[02:25.30]够了，让我一个人待一会儿
[02:28.30]别说了，听累了你的解释
[02:32.80]一滴两滴…泣不成声，泣涕如雨
[02:35.80]但对于毫无价值，毫无作用…
[02:39.80]够了，闭嘴！别再说了
[02:42.80]不想再听你谎言…悲痛欲绝
[02:46.80]一滴两滴…泣不成声，泣涕如雨
[02:49.80]然而这都对你无足轻重
[03:16.80]
[03:24.80]心疼我的花样青春…..

[by:nurnesa]
[00:19.42]我的心在不断地
[00:22.96]思念你 呼唤你

[00:46.45]没了你 所有一切都将黯淡无光
[00:56.99]思念 让我陷入痛苦

[01:19.45]追寻你

[01:27.58]我的心不断地不断地
[01:31.15]质问我你在何方

[02:21.72]我的心不断地想念你

[02:42.87]我的心不断地不断地
[02:46.40]质问我 你在何方
[02:50.18]我的心不断的
[02:53.38]思念你 思念你

[03:08.75]什么感觉 什么梦想

data.tlyric:
[00:07.15]没能送给你的玫瑰最终也只是留在我手心
[00:12.85]或许也不配称之为玫瑰，只是枯枝败叶
[00:17.73]花花草草倒会枯萎
[00:20.66]又或许哪天面对凋谢
[00:21.90]可我这可怜的心
[00:25.51]它想要的唯唯只是你的
[00:28.90]彻夜不能入眠，自从你离我而去
[00:34.20]无论如何我不是只爱你一个人的吗？
[00:39.69]也罢，孤独寂寞也会过去
[00:42.69]或许某天也会有爱恋降临
[00:43.57]但我这可怜的心
[00:46.28]它只是想要你的啊
[00:50.48]必需，必要，不可或缺
[00:53.20]这颗心或许没你无法继续跳动
[00:56.88]心田、心坎
[00:58.42]这颗心也许不再会安然如故
[01:02.60]我已知晓，这颗心也不要安慰自我陶醉...
[01:08.9]它想要的不过只是你而已的吗？
[01:12.13]必要，必需，必不可少
[01:14.68]我心或许失去你会无法承受
[01:18.73]心田、心坎
[01:20.33]这颗心也许不再会安然如故
[01:23.59]我已发觉，这颗心也不再会被安慰所骗...
[01:29.81]唯唯你，是我这颗心所求
[01:33.65]不可或缺
[01:54.35]孤单一人，愁眉锁眼，毫无愉悦
[02:00.47]是你的容颜才能给我所需的温暖
[02:06.10]或许时间会治愈
[02:09.10]所有都会过去
[02:10.71]可我这可怜的一颗心
[02:12.93]它想要的不过只是你而已的吗？
[02:16.47]你说，你对我这颗心说，它该为你做什么才好？
[02:21.83]你说，它应该怎么爱你，怎么歌咏对你的爱才好？
[02:27.26]伤疤或许哪天会得以痊愈
[02:30.35]但这颗心这下该等待谁？
[02:32.29]支离破碎的这颗心
[02:34.87]这下谁还会需要它？
[02:38.13]必需，必要，不可或缺
[02:40.71]我心或许没你无法继续跳动
[02:45.2]心田、心坎
[02:46.43]这颗心也许不再会安然如故
[02:50.40]我已知晓，这颗心也不要安慰自我陶醉...
[02:56.9]它想要的不过只是你而已的吗？
[02:59.65]必需，必要，无可比拟
[03:02.64]无法承受，许失去你会天崩地裂
[03:06.61]心田、心坎
[03:08.7]这颗心也许不再会安然如故
[03:12.4]我已发觉，这颗心也不再想被安慰麻醉...
[03:17.48]它想要的不过只是你而已的吗？
[03:20.87]无可比拟

[00:01.00] 作曲 : мавлан музыка/еяхат музыка
[00:26.12]Ko'zlaringdan, qidirardim
[00:29.06]Lekin ko'rmadim, man o'zimni
[00:31.61]Ketaverding, qaramasdan
[00:34.44]Tinglamasdan yor so'nggi so'zimni
[00:34.65]Tugadi bari o'rtamizda
[00:40.87]Kotta to'siq bor qaragin
[00:43.42]Xech bo'lmasa jonim
[00:44.86]Meni ko'rganingda, shirin so'zlarga yaragin
[00:49.15]Uni sog'inib, o'tmoqda har kunim
[00:54.58]U siz o'tmoqda, azobli har tunim
[01:00.41]Shirin so'zlarga, uchib ketdi go'zalim
[01:03.34]U chiroyida, hammadan o'zarim
[01:11.36]Balki qolmadi, menga bir so'zing
[01:14.25]Meni ko'rishga, ayt yo'qmi ko'zing
[01:17.39]Bu dunyoda seni qolarman ko'rib
[01:20.08]Ungacha ishon bo'larman o'lib
[01:22.81]Balki qolmadi, sevgidan nishon
[01:25.55]Jonim so'inib, qoldimku ishon
[01:28.45]Qanchalar seni, sevgandim yorim
[01:31.28]Axir tark etding tinglamay zorim
[01:56.73]Negadur bu dunyoda baxtga erisholmadim
[01:59.52]O'zimni g'uririm bilan kelisholmadim
[02:02.26]Charchadim hiyonatdan yaralgan bevafolardan
[02:05.40]Sanga vada berib aldagan bedavolardan
[02:08.02]Yurardim quvonib baxtga to'lib ketgandim
[02:10.86]Ko'zimni oldida o'zga bilan ketgandi
[02:13.99]U qilgan hiyonatga qanaqa asos bor
[02:16.55]Boshqalardan kam emasdi emasdi pulga zor
[02:19.49]Jonimni beraymi yoki borimni beraymi
[02:22.03]Yana yoningga yana qaytib kelaymi
[02:30.28]Jonimni beraymi yoki borimni beraymi
[02:36.10]Yana yoningga yana qaytib kelaymi
[02:41.73]Balki qolmadi, menga bir so'zing
[02:44.71]Meni ko'rishga, ayt yo'qmi ko'zing
[02:47.45]Bu dunyoda seni qolarman ko'rib
[02:50.25]Ungacha ishon bo'larman o'lib
[02:53.30]Balki qolmadi, sevgidan nishon
[02:55.99]Jonim so'inib, qoldimku ishon

[03:01.61]Axir tark etding tinglamay zorim

[by:难忘的回忆E]
[00:26.12]你的眼神里
[00:29.06]看不见我自己
[00:31.61]不理我就要走了
[00:34.44]也不想听了我的几句话
[00:34.65]我们之间全没了
[00:40.87]再也没有机会了
[00:43.42]至少你
[00:44.86]遇见我时，说几句好话
[00:49.15]日日夜夜思念她
[00:54.58]没有他的每一刻都很伤感
[01:00.41]你的每一句话，在没有机会听到
[01:03.34]她的笑容是最美的
[01:11.36]也许你不想跟我说话
[01:14.25]也不想再次看见我
[01:17.39]也可能我会遇见你
[01:20.08]那时什么都无所谓
[01:22.81]也许我没了爱情信物
[01:25.55]我想你了，相信我
[01:28.45]多么爱你
[01:31.28]总会你不要我了
[01:56.73]这一辈子没得到什么
[01:59.52]只能说自己对不起
[02:02.26]累了我再也不想了
[02:05.40]说好了在一起，但你走了
[02:08.02]吃了自己的醋
[02:10.86]眼前的你和他走了
[02:13.99]她贪污爱情
[02:16.55]反正我也没缺点什么
[02:19.49]我给你我的一切
[02:22.03]只想回你身边
[02:30.28]我给你我的一切
[02:36.10]只想再次回你身边
[02:41.73]也许你对我不怎么样
[02:44.71]也不想跟我在一起
[02:47.45]也可能我会遇见你
[02:50.25]那时什么都无所谓
[02:53.30]也许我没了爱情信物
[02:55.99]我想你了，相信我
[02:58.77]多么爱你
[03:01.61]总会你不要我了
[03:05.08]也许再也没了
